newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shows strength, countering drop in Dow.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shows strength, countering drop in Dow.

text.p: Nasdaq shares continued to rise for the fourth consecutive session as a broad rally in technology stocks extended to small capitalization stocks, which have been overlooked in recent weeks, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 9.74 points or 0.77 percent to close unofficially at 1270.50. The rise offset a 33 point or 0.46 percent drop in the Dow industrials, which closed unofficially at 6976.
Advancing Nasdaq issues beat declining issues 2356 to 1811 on total volume of 621 million shares. Nasdaq shares have risen in eight of the previous 10 sessions.
"It's a continuation of what we've seen in the past few days. Some big name techs have been strong lately, but the strength has spread through all the (technology) sectors," one trader said.

Networking stocks continued their recent ascent, while technology heavyweights Intel Corp and Dell Computer Corp also firmed. This optimism helped boost smaller companies such as Discreet Logic and Cylink Corp, traders said.
Traders also pointed to VLSI Technology Inc, which gained 2 to 21-7/8 after a bullish revenue forecast.
